summary: Add NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE boolean column marketing_opt_in to account_user via expand SQL stage before deploy_new, backfill any NULLs to FALSE, deploy_new with state_only to own the schema change without running the new version's migration, retire_old after which only the new version serves traffic. Old version inserts receive DB default False; new version sets field explicitly, ensuring no NULLs during concurrent operation.
write_consistency: Old version INSERT/UPDATE omits marketing_opt_in, PostgreSQL assigns DB default False; new version explicitly sets the field. NOT NULL constraint and DEFAULT False ensure no NULLs persist across both versions' concurrent traffic.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE to account_user
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

stages.description: Set marketing_opt_in to FALSE for any rows that may have NULL
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = FALSE WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version; after this only new version serves traffic
